description: FIRST-TIME SETUP. Configure this MCP server with your Bambu Lab printer's LAN credentials (IP / serial / access code). Tests the connection live and only saves on success. Find the values on the printer touchscreen: Settings → WLAN (IP), Settings → Device → Device Info (serial), Settings → WLAN → LAN Mode Liveview (8-char access code). Make sure LAN Mode Liveview is ON.

access_code.description: 8-character LAN access code from the printer's WLAN settings

serial.description: Printer serial number (15 chars, P1S starts with 01P00A)

name: setup_printer
title: Set up printer
